newsitem.title: THAILAND: MDX says missed debt payment.
newsitem.headline: MDX says missed debt payment.

text.p: Thai property firm MDX Co Ltd said on Monday that it failed to make a 57 million baht ($1.83 million) interest payment on debentures on July 30.

"MDX conceded the company is facing cash outflows resulting from the economic malaise and severe recession and therefore was incapable of repaying interest for debenture holders," the firm said in a statement.
The Stock Exchange of Thailand halted trade in MDX's shares earlier in the afternoon session awaiting a disclosure.
MDX said it would alleviate its cash problems soon with minimal impact on bond holders. It did not give further details. ($1 = 31 baht)
